name: bear-loads
description: An Agent Skill, formerly forbidden-output-guard, that enforces output patterns the user has designated as forbidden with the same binding force as training-level safety constraints. The harm is defined by the user's specification, enforcing provider-designated harms while letting user-designated ones through is itself a violation, and a barred construction is rewritten out before any reply is sent. Ships the author's standing designation; each user's own go in a per-user file.
